epistemicQualifiers.claimText: we're going to do this — requesting access, at least up to the Presidency of the Republic, because the order has to come from the top down
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: Therefore, there was no sense, in this first hearing, Deputy, in bringing military personnel here to hear this. First, we need to set out what is happening, explicitly and publicly state it so they can provide information within the scope of the law, because we have been requesting this for a long time, since the law came into effect. We access Gov.br, which is the platform where each person has their own record. Today, everyone files their income tax through Gov.br, everyone has this right, and the LAI (Law on Access to Information) facilitates this. We access Cidic — the Document Indexing Code that contains Classified Information — and search for this information, but we cannot find it, there is no way to find it using the LAI, understand, Deputy? This is our problem. We need to address this issue using, of course, the Commission, the power the Commission has to enforce this, because these documents need to be made public. The LAI itself mandates that these documents be placed in a hall of declassified or classified documents. It's like looking for a needle in a haystack, because it's an enormous code. We have some examples here of our attempts. It's an enormous code, and there's no way to say: "Look, if this is classified, what information does it contain on UFO matters?" There's no way to identify this to request the document through the LAI. It's very specific. The LAI can be good today, for example, when you already know the subject. Then, if you activate the LAI: "Look, the subject is this, I'm interested in this and that, and this is the information I want." The LAI provides that information. But old documents, especially those from before the Constitution, we have no access to. For example, we have the films from Operation Prato. Indeed, Thiago has already accessed frames from this film, it's at least 15 minutes of footage. Where is it? We've already requested it from the Air Force, the process reached the Controladoria-Geral da União, but it stopped there. The official, who said they don't have this information, has public faith. So, it's there in the LAI, but it stopped there and there's no further recourse. This is a difficulty that the CBU faces. Unfortunately, we once again have to appeal to our beloved Deputy Chico Alencar, our ufological deputy. Thank God we have a deputy open to this subject, who brings it up publicly, makes the Chamber fulfill its role, which is to bring this serious matter to debate. Here, we didn't go into details due to time constraints, but this is extremely serious and has a religious and political impact. There was interference from the United States in the case, violating our sovereignty, because they took the debris of the fallen object to Varginha. This had to have generated documentation. We tried, Deputy, even with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to obtain documents that would attest to the exit of these objects, of the creatures. There are none, there's no way to access this via LAI. Therefore, our denunciation is on record. We are making this denunciation and once again — I don't know how we're going to do this — requesting access, at least up to the Presidency of the Republic, because the order has to come from the top down. We requested assistance from the Office of the President, from the Civil House, as we did with the UFO Brazil Dossier, and we gained access. As the Deputy said, there are over 10,000 documents at the National Archives. As the late Gevaerd would say, it's all just window dressing. There's much more serious stuff hidden by the military power. I don't know by whose order, but the people have a right to access this.

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: you were present at the opening — to central issues of everyday life, such as the Gaza massacre, the war in Ukraine, Brazil's social inequalities, and the attempted coup with a new amnesty bill whose text no one has seen yet in Congress
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: I want to apologize to the guests, because he went into ad hominem attacks, disparaging a conversation that some may not like, or find out of touch. But there is a dedication from us, as I mentioned at the beginning — I don't know if you were present at the opening — to central issues of everyday life, such as the Gaza massacre, the war in Ukraine, Brazil's social inequalities, and the attempted coup with a new amnesty bill whose text no one has seen yet in Congress. This is within the scope of our concerns. MR. VICTOR RATTES - I would like to request the right of reply, Mr. President. MR. PRESIDENT (Chico Alencar. Bloco/PSOL - RJ) - No, there are other speakers on the list. You already had your time and finished speaking before the 2-minute limit. Now, our Carlos has the floor, please. (Pause.) I apologize for the slight offense he made, even with his attire, to mock, but everything is fine. Of course, everyone can dress as they wish. But one cannot come naked here, because that would be a violation of decency. Now, there are frequent violations of ethics and decorum in Congress. (Pause.) I will give the floor back briefly for 2 minutes for Thiago to explain what ufology is. Some people don't understand. MR. THIAGO LUIZ TICCHETTI - Unfortunately, Victor mixed the wheat with the chaff. If he knew a little about ufology, he would see that we are against the so-called ET Bilu. Victor, it's more than just a partisan and political debate, because everyone has their political stance. We are talking about freedom of information and a citizen's right, something you should be fighting for, something you should be defending. (Unintelligible intervention from the microphone.) No, we are here discussing a topic, and any topic can be raised in the Participative Legislation Commission. We managed to get a Deputy to support us. That's all. Don't say that everyone here is a clown, that this is a circus. There are no clowns here. These are people who investigate, dedicate their lives and time with their families to serious research. So, when you speak, speak politely. Don't put everyone in the same bag, okay?

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: it is extremely timely - to speak about two very important aspects: rights and duties
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: MR. CARLOS ODONE DA COSTA NUNES - Thank you very much. Good morning everyone. I am grateful for the initiative of Deputy Chico Alencar in providing ufologists with the opportunity to discuss a so serious and grave topic, as has been brought up here on several occasions. Therefore, it is an honor for me to participate in this public hearing as the Secretary of the Brazilian Commission of Ufologists - CBU. Ufology is a topic of extreme importance, and I would say, of a very special significance, as it concerns all of us, the terrestrial humanity. I take this opportunity - I believe it is extremely timely - to speak about two very important aspects: rights and duties. Backed by the LAI, we have the right to know about everything that is happening, about the truth of the occurrences that marked UFO phenomenon manifestations in our country. I am referring to the events in Varginha and the cases related to Operation Plate in the Northern region of Brazil, especially regarding what was and continues to be hidden. This cover-up demands an opening without restrictions. The CBU, established in 1996, has already reached almost 3 decades of relentless struggle in search of answers, in search of the truth about all the events that have occurred in this country. The Brazilian Commission of Ufologists has not spared efforts during this entire period of almost 30 years, performing an unwavering work until reaching this historic public hearing situation. Therefore, Mr. Deputy, it is time for the Brazilian society to unite to make the uncovering a wake-up call for consciousness, so that it represents that we are, with much awareness, taking knowledge that we are visited, accompanied, monitored. With all this, the old slogan that everyone here knows applies: They are among us.

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: it is important to highlight that all recent U
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: Who, in our country, is better equipped to record these phenomena than the person who gave the testimony and treated it as if it were entirely outside the realm of credibility? It is our military, and they are the ones who have generated this type of documentation. I ask, Deputy: why didn't Lieutenant-Brigadier Moreira Lima seek out—note that this is not against science, as I defend it—a scientist to explain what he told me? Why didn't Sócrates Monteiro ever do that? Because, often, very serious people in the scientific field find themselves unable to take a position in favor of what we defend, precisely because of this completely absurd line of thinking after so many years of worldwide recorded evidence. I am not a partisan of any type of American politics, nor will I defend any of them, but I believe it is important to highlight that all recent U.S. Presidents have included ufology in their platforms—that's the story of "If elected..."—That's not a serious country, because it deals with this starting from its Presidents. Do these Presidents not have any idea of what is science and what is not? Science is certainly not what was presented or defended here. (Applause.) MR. FERNANDO DE ARAGÃO RAMALHO - To conclude, since our colleagues have already said everything, I would like to suggest to that person to go to the National Archives. There is the report that Lieutenant-Brigadier Júlio Moreira Lima promised to release. CBU gained access to the document, which does not mention "extraterrestrial," but states that it is intelligent and not our technology or American technology. That one put the FAB jets to shame. It was flying at Mach 15. What kind of technology is that? Where does it come from? The very brigadier who signs the report says: "This is not ours. It may not be manned, but it's intelligent." Our friend, who is an astronomer, could at least suggest where it comes from. Obviously, we are open to discussion. But where does it come from? It is a topic of study in ufology. If this is not science, then what is? Ask the military, go to the National Archives, study ufology. Don't just criticize, like the guy who came here and talked a lot of nonsense because he doesn't know. This is prejudice and exists within academia. Let it be clear: talking about ufology within academia is a taboo. Thank God, some universities already have doctorate programs in the area—people are talking about the subject. A person who brings such a conversation is completely out of touch. This is pure prejudice. (Applause.) MR. PRESIDENT (Chico Alencar. Block/PSOL - RJ) - I thank everyone again, including those who participated indirectly, regardless of their opinions. I am also from academia. I even became a doctor a bit late—a not senile, not old citizen, but already old. I have great respect for science, but I believe that the explanation of the world does not end there. I am not dogmatic.

documents.title: Dossiê de Registro — Caso ET de Varginha

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: that even coffee pales in comparison to the ET
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: Varginha. The idea is that now the public power should be part of this diffusion, impulsion, and safeguarding actions. It is important to highlight that, as a cultural fact, the Varginha ET Case was forged by the Varginha community itself, by ufologists, and by those who appropriated some good in order to create versions and representations that have been perpetuated in national and world memory. We can surely affirm that the Varginha ET Case and all the representations, narratives, mysteries, and mythifications it sparked, have made it a good far beyond the territorial limits of Varginha. The Varginha ET Case and everything surrounding it has a national reach. The current mayor, Vérdi Melo, stated regarding the Registry that "The ET Case made our city world-known. Today, we receive visitors from all over, scholars of the case spread the story of Varginha, and it is up to us, public managers, to take care of this illustrious visitor who chose our city to land." For José Manoel Magalhães Ferreira, president of the Municipal Cultural Heritage Council of Varginha, "whether or not the ET existed is not the main issue. The truth is that this phenomenon transformed the way the city is seen and perceived." "If they ask me what is Varginha's identity, I believe that even coffee pales in comparison to the ET. We are the largest coffee commercial center in Brazil and the world, but we are better known for the ET," José Manoel reinforces. In the municipality, there is a unanimous opinion that the Varginha ET Case has indelebilly marked the identity of the municipality and the way it is seen and represented. Even children demonstrate this understanding through drawings, as shown in the Education Heritage section. For all the reasons presented in this Registration Dossier and due to its representative, symbolic, identity, and cultural values, the cultural good "The ET Case and Varginha's Identity" was indicated for studies and Registered as Intangible Cultural Heritage of Varginha.

epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: In the wake of the new decade's beginning, in the year that brings all sorts of happiness, I am sending this letter with the hope of illuminating a matter that has long been a subject of concern, apart from the horrors of war. I wish to propose a course of action regarding the recent observations of unidentified flying objects (UFOs), which have been reported with increasing frequency. These phenomena, while intriguing, have raised numerous questions and concerns. I have been involved in the study of these objects for several years, and I believe it is time to take a more systematic approach to understanding them. I propose the following: 1. **Documentation and Collection of Data:** I encourage everyone, especially those with access to advanced technology, to document and record their observations. This includes detailed descriptions, photographs, and videos of the UFOs. 2. **Centralized Reporting:** Establish a centralized system for reporting UFO sightings. This will help in organizing and analyzing the data more effectively. 3. **Scientific Investigation:** I suggest forming a committee of scientists, engineers, and astronomers to study the collected data. Their expertise can help interpret the observations and determine their origin. 4. **International Collaboration:** Given the global nature of these phenomena, international collaboration is essential. Sharing information and resources will enhance the overall research effort. By taking these steps, we can move from mere speculation to a more informed understanding of these mysterious visitors from unknown realms. I am confident that with dedication and scientific rigor, we can unravel the secrets surrounding UFOs. I look forward to your responses and any additional insights you may have. Yours sincerely, [Sender

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: that those events in 1959 were the exclusive fruit of the interest of Brigadiere Vaz and some of his officers serving in that region of the country
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: Major Brigadiere Lúcio Starling de Carvalho, In 1954, I collaborated with then Col. João Adil de Oliveira during the FIRST OFFICIAL INQUIRY INTO "UAP" - Unidentified Aerial Phenomena - opened by then Minister Eduardo Somes. In 1957, after the photographs taken from the deck of the Admiral Saldanha ship near Trindade Island, I was granted permission to examine the files of the Navy General Staff. In 1959, authorized by then Brigadiere João Adil de Oliveira, I produced twelve television programs - on Sundays - making public everything that the FAB had investigated in 1952 and 1954. In the old Monroe Palace - ENFA - I was conversing with then Maj. Brigadiere José Vaz da Silva, shortly after he left the command of the 4th Air Zone. Then Brigadiere Delio, who took over the command of the 4th Air Zone, put the files of the "SIOANI" - System for Investigating Unidentified Aerial Phenomena - at my disposal. I believe that those events in 1959 were the exclusive fruit of the interest of Brigadiere Vaz and some of his officers serving in that region of the country. Today, having gone to São Paulo to see the documentation, I considered it a military secret and could not wait for the other day. Only recently did I gain knowledge of the magnificent work designed and partially executed by Brigadiere Vaz, now in the public domain. I believe that was the most significant event of that time, witnessed by over 300 people, fully published in my book "STRANGE SIGNS" and documented with a statement from a superior official of the FAB whose name I kept anonymous. They suggested that it might have been a weather phenomenon or a military aircraft, but the descriptions from witnesses don't match any known aircraft models. IV - Today, I've been trying to reach out to experts in the field of ufology to discuss this event. I want to understand if there's any scientific explanation for what I saw or if it's something more extraordinary. I'm hoping to gain some clarity and perhaps contribute to the ongoing study of these mysterious sky objects.

epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: I witnessed a strange phenomenon in the sky last night. Around 10 PM, I saw a bright, circular object moving at an incredible speed. It was unlike anything I've ever seen before, and it quickly disappeared from view. I'm not sure what it was, but it left me with a sense of wonder and mystery. II - Several people in my neighborhood reported similar sightings last night. They described seeing a UFO (unidentified flying object) with lights that seemed to change colors as it moved. Some even claimed to have seen it for several minutes before it vanished. III - The local police received multiple calls about the incident, but they were unable to locate the object or identify any potential witnesses. They suggested that it might have been a weather phenomenon or a military aircraft, but the descriptions from witnesses don't match any known aircraft models. IV - Today, I've been trying to reach out to experts in the field of ufology to discuss this event. I want to understand if there's any scientific explanation for what I saw or if it's something more extraordinary. I'm hoping to gain some clarity and perhaps contribute to the ongoing study of these mysterious sky objects.

II - Several people in my neighborhood reported similar sightings last night. They described seeing a UFO (unidentified flying object) with lights that seemed to change colors as it moved. Some even claimed to have seen it for several minutes before it vanished. III - The local police received multiple calls about the incident, but they were unable to locate the object or identify any potential witnesses. They suggested that it might have been a weather phenomenon or a military aircraft, but the descriptions from witnesses don't match any known aircraft models. IV - Today, I've been trying to reach out to experts in the field of ufology to discuss this event. I want to understand if there's any scientific explanation for what I saw or if it's something more extraordinary. I'm hoping to gain some clarity and perhaps contribute to the ongoing study of these mysterious sky objects.

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: it was a flying saucer," Neto continues, "but I felt that behind the red light that emanated from its base, someone was observing our reactions
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: What seemed to be a flying object was seen in Itaguaí (Itaguai) — Another fantastic story about the appearance of a flying object, this time in the town of Itaguaí, continues to engage the public opinion of this municipality, divided into two currents: those who believe and those who approach the narrative of brothers José Maria Braga and José Maria gp with reservations. Both affirm they saw, in the early hours of Saturday, a circular object that radiated intense luminosity, casting reflections on a field of grass lit by the sun, at the range of the Santa Cruz Air Base, where the cattle were grazing. Almost five o'clock, when Neto, according to their accounts, saw an object "radiating a light of all colors" in the middle of the field. They say that the light, in comparison to the moonlight, "gave a different color to the night and the place." "I, Neto says, who had just woken up and was driving my truck to pick up the earth from the power plant of Eletrobrás, saw, with my brother: who was traveling with me in the back of our truck, GB 6-98-84, intended to look at the light in the middle of the field. Immediately, out of simple curiosity, we jumped and looked closely. The strange object was emitting a light that cast shadows on the ground." "I don't know if it was a flying saucer," Neto continues, "but I felt that behind the red light that emanated from its base, someone was observing our reactions."

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: in the existence of life on other plan- ets because the evidence is there
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: that we would be watched. If we, within all these scientifically proven principles, are constantly spying on the Universe, wouldn't someone else be doing the same? And since they are more advanced, they would obviously have better conditions to study us. | It is not the fact that science proves certain principles that would lead us not to accept contrary things. It just so happens that these same principles could be "used by other beings in a different way. Once proven scientifically here, it is clear that it applies to the entire Universe. From the moment a study is taken to a higher level, one could never reach a conclusion with just two answers. And NASA did just that in one of its expeditions. If it was not proven to exist, how can they say it is true? Also, no one has been able to make someone retract such a statement. They saw it, period, and that's it! Is it possible that in a Universe so infinitely vast, there is only us? Currently, at the same time a program is airing in Sweden, we can watch it at home, tranquilly; in the future, a camera will be on Saturn, and you will also be able to see it in the same way. Perhaps no cameras will even be needed. From here, we would tune in to what we are supposed to see. Wouldn't that happen in their civil- ization right now? Despite all of this, I believe in the existence of life on other plan- ets because the evidence is there. But to recognize this truth, we can never look at them through the limited human perspective. The world is vast, and the knowledge that emerges is also vast, and what does man know about himself? What about the others? Benny Shamss - Capital.

epistemicQualifiers.claimText: that every person who proposes to opine on a subject, directly or indirectly, is concerned with it
epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: | To: Mr. Editor; I request, at your kindness, to include this letter in your section, necessary for the proper understanding of a matter of great importance. | Regarding: A response to your letter, "LAST MINUTE, 24/4/1969," concerning the problematic and disturbing issue of flying saucers. | It is undeniable that flying saucers are a subject that arouses curiosity, ignites discussions, and in the minds of enlightened individuals, lights the flame of an ideal, that is, contact with them. However, in view of this, while many people have undertaken positive research, information, and clarification efforts regarding flying saucers, it is also necessary to state that just as many individuals have used the same issue for questionable purposes, without integrity or moderation. This group includes Mr. José A. da Silva. This gentleman, to my knowledge, has but one purpose: to "appear." | Mr. José A. da Silva: I am opposed to the polemic, having taken into consideration your aforementioned letter, in response to Mr. Reginaldo in this same forum, and totally disagreeing with it, I reserve the right to express my contrary opinion. | Dear Sir, I believe that every person who proposes to opine on a subject, directly or indirectly, is concerned with it. You, therefore, are not the exception to the rule. Given this, flying saucers concern us, despite your formal denial of their existence. | My dear Sir, if my assertion is correct, I believe you should respect my opinion, even if it is levian. | If, on the other hand, I am in error, you are wasting your time, not to mention annoying readers with your chatter. Let us then come to what you have to say. In your letter, you cited a well-known scientist, Dr. Herman W. Oberth, and used a mystical term, besides distorting the truth to make us believe that the cited scientist, propagating what would be a condemnable lie. | My dear Sir, your opinion is unconvincing, levian, and imbued with bad faith. You cast a disreputable statement over the name of a scientific person, one that you cannot prove, nor do you present arguments to support it. | Since this is the case, it has sufficed for me to make a superficial reading of your letter to understand that you do not have the slightest regard for men of science. This does not surprise me, as it seems to me that you are the type who believes he knows it all, and that the world and its events always revolve around him.

epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: | To: Mr. Editor; I request, at your kindness, to include this letter in your section, necessary for the proper understanding of a matter of great importance. | Regarding: A response to your letter, "LAST MINUTE, 24/4/1969," concerning the problematic and disturbing issue of flying saucers. | It is undeniable that flying saucers are a subject that arouses curiosity, ignites discussions, and in the minds of enlightened individuals, lights the flame of an ideal, that is, contact with them. However, in view of this, while many people have undertaken positive research, information, and clarification efforts regarding flying saucers, it is also necessary to state that just as many individuals have used the same issue for questionable purposes, without integrity or moderation. This group includes Mr. José A. da Silva. This gentleman, to my knowledge, has but one purpose: to "appear." | Mr. José A. da Silva: I am opposed to the polemic, having taken into consideration your aforementioned letter, in response to Mr. Reginaldo in this same forum, and totally disagreeing with it, I reserve the right to express my contrary opinion. | Dear Sir, I believe that every person who proposes to opine on a subject, directly or indirectly, is concerned with it. You, therefore, are not the exception to the rule. Given this, flying saucers concern us, despite your formal denial of their existence. | My dear Sir, if my assertion is correct, I believe you should respect my opinion, even if it is levian. | If, on the other hand, I am in error, you are wasting your time, not to mention annoying readers with your chatter. Oberth, and used a mystical term, besides distorting the truth to make us believe that the cited scientist, propagating what would be a condemnable lie. | My dear Sir, your opinion is unconvincing, levian, and imbued with bad faith. epistemicQualifiers.evidenceExcerpt: problem: regarding an episode and a coincidence following the supposed appearance of an ET, where two hospitals in the city were the stage for unusual movements. No unusual activity was reported at either hospital, though a special case was investigated. in the past month, men were searching for a trace from the column, which involved a student engineer, son of a local family. After a trip, they proposed to publicly publish the story of a family from the city that had encountered a living alien. They spoke of a dead alien found in a cell of the city's jail, after being arrested. According to Luiza, the civil police chief, an investigation was conducted. "It was only later that we learned the truth," says Rodrigues.
